reviews.title: Excellent Little Monitor
reviews.comment: I purchased this to supplement a very small 14 inch monitor on my Dell Inspiron 14, and the devices meshed like they had always been used together. I have been using the monitor at work for a week, with a 14hr constant duty time each night without a snag. From the get go I was pleased: the price was good, the packaging and arrival shape was perfect, and the setup was too easy to call setup and didnt really require instructions. The provided cords are good quality and to be frank I was surprised they were provided in this day. As for weight... the thing is super light eight and I do not notice the extra weight in my PC bag at all. As far as build quality, out of the box, I am actually not just "not disappointed" but I am truly impressed. Hinges are sound and hold position well, button, port, etc are all good quality and feel sturdy and the speakers are decent (better than expected for size - in fact they are much louder than my laptops system). The screen can always be brighter for me ,but again - I love this little Dell that I use and it seems to be a bit brighter than that screen as well. Hot swap / plugging and messing around with software caused no glitches or concerns. Even when not using at work I plan to use this little guy for phones or extra home laptop viewing real estate as needed. If your looking at different monitors and would prefer one with a solid integrated stand , this hinge / setup seems to be excellent and I can highly recommend even if you are considering something a bit cheaper, go ahead and spend the extra 10-15 bucks, you wont regret it in this case.
reviews.author: DOC

reviews.title: Great product and great customer service
reviews.comment:
I ordered this monitor for a trip where I needed to work remotely.  It was a great companion to my smaller-screen laptop and made working much more efficient than just my laptop.  It's really lightweight and has adjustable sound/brightness.  It also didn't add any bulk to my luggage which is exactly what I was looking for.
This is a great company to purchase from - their customer service is top notch.  I reached out to them about a carry case after reading a previous review and they sent one with no questions asked, for free!  I also had a concern with the noise coming from the fan and once I was back from my trip they sent me a new monitor to test.  They were very keen to solving the issue.  The new screen had slightly less noise coming from the fan and after a while you barely notice it.  Being at the price point it is, I was fine with it.
I would highly recommend this screen if you're in the market for an affordable travel-friendly low-bulk second screen.
reviews.author: Nicole Bachman

reviews.title: All around excellent portable monitor!
reviews.comment:
This UPERFECT 15.6" monitor is an absolute sleeper hit for anyone on the go. The 1080P IPS panel is crisp enough for everything from coding in a terminal to catching up on YouTube, and the 10-point touchscreen is surprisingly snappy. It’s basically the ultimate power move for a foldable phone or a handheld setup—plugging in via a single USB-C cable and getting an instant desktop experience without any lag is a total game-changer.
The matte finish is the star here, though. If you’ve ever tried to work in a coffee shop or near a window with a glossy screen, you know the struggle of staring at your own reflection all day. This anti-glare coating handles harsh overhead lights like a pro and, even better, it doesn't turn into a greasy fingerprint graveyard the second you start using the touch controls. You lose a tiny bit of that "ultra-saturated" look, but for actual productivity and long sessions, your eyes will definitely thank you.
Build-wise, it’s lean enough to slide into a bag right next to a laptop or tablet without adding annoying bulk. The aluminum frame feels premium, not plasticky, and having the mini-HDMI port as a backup is great for older gear or specialized rigs.
If you're looking to level up your portable dual-screen game or just want a solid external display that can take a bit of a beating on the road, this is an easy pick. It’s reliable, looks stealthy, and just works.
reviews.author: Kai Hoffman

reviews.title: Beware of the cables
reviews.comment:
product is perfect but beware of the cables
1. If you are using windows as source, make sure your pc's usb-c port supports video output (it is related to motherboard), if not you can only use usb-a and hdmi to transmit the video signal
2. Related to 1., the hdmi cable is short (3.3ft), so if you are using a height adjustable desk where you put the PC on the ground and you want to stand up, it almost certainly is not long enough, you would need to buy another cable.
reviews.author: Alex

reviews.title: Stylish and Lightweight
reviews.comment: I started looking for a small and lightweight monitor for my travel. This monitor is very light and stylish. It also comes with a nice soft case. I had no problem in connecting it using USB-C cable to my Microsoft Surface Pro 11.  I do not game but the resolution is good enough to read documents for my work. It even has speakers.  I could use the menu buttons to adjust brightness, blue light, volume, etc. It’s perfect for my travel. I highly recommend it!
reviews.author: Customer
